title.purpose: Card titles, sub-section heads, admin page titles.

body.purpose: Editorial prose at 1.0625rem; UI text steps down to 0.9375rem. Measure 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Status pills, badges, display-ID tags, eyebrow markers. Uppercase mono.

shadows.name: elev-1
shadows.purpose: Resting state for cards and raised surfaces. Reads as a printed edge, not a float.

shadows.name: elev-3
shadows.purpose: Hover and active overlays only. Never a rest state.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all structural state transitions.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Subtle overshoot. Playful interactive moments only, never structural UI.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Card hover: shadow, transform, border together.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Ceiling. Keep all UI motion at or under this.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action. Navy fill on paper, compact 32px height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:32px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:12px; background:var(--jaipur-navy,#082746); color:var(--paper,#FAF7EE); font-family:'Geist Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--jaipur-navy,#082746), transparent 20%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-clay,#EA580C); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Warm hairline on the paper ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:32px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--line,#E5E0D5); border-radius:12px; background:var(--paper,#FAF7EE); color:var(--ink,#0F172A); font-family:'Geist Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--paper-warm,#F2EDE0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-clay,#EA580C); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Status Pill — Available
components.description: Listing availability. Uppercase mono with a leading dot.
components.css: .ds-pill-available { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--ok-mist,#DCFCE7); color:#0F7A37; font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace; font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-pill-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ok-green,#16A34A); }

components.name: Badge — Warn
components.description: Attention state. The rationed terracotta accent in badge form.
components.css: .ds-badge-warn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #E7CBBB; background:var(--terracotta-mist,#F5E4DA); color:var(--terracotta,#B5532E); font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em; line-height:1.45; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Display-ID Tag
components.description: The ledger's signature mark — every listing's entry number.
components.css: .ds-tag-id { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid var(--line,#E5E0D5); background:var(--paper-snow,#FFFFFF); color:var(--ink-muted,#475569); font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em; }

components.name: Listing Card
components.description: The catalog entry. Flat at rest, lifts on intent.
components.html:
2BHK in Malviya Nagar

₹24,000 / month · Semi-furnished
components.css: .ds-card-listing { background:var(--paper-snow,#FFFFFF); border:1px solid var(--line,#E5E0D5); border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(8,39,70,.04),0 1px 3px rgba(8,39,70,.06); transition:box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-card-listing:hover { box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(8,39,70,.10), 0 0 0 1px rgba(8,39,70,.05); border-color:rgba(8,39,70,.18); transform:translateY(-3px); } .ds-card-listing:active { transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-card-body { padding:16px; } .ds-card-title { margin:0 0 4px; font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink,#0F172A); } .ds-card-meta { margin:0; font-family:'Geist Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.9375rem; color:var(--ink-muted,#475569); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Transparent ground, hairline border, navy focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height:32px; width:100%; padding:4px 10px; border:1px solid var(--line,#E5E0D5); border-radius:12px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink,#0F172A); font-family:'Geist Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; outline:none; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-soft,#94A3B8); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--jaipur-navy,#082746); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--jaipur-navy,#082746), transparent 50%); }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Fixed 64px header on the paper ground with a hairline base rule.

narrative.overview:
Rentoo looks like a well-kept book of accounts, not a listings portal. Every property enters the system as a numbered entry (#01, #02) set in monospace, ruled off from its neighbours by a single warm hairline, and stamped with its status. The ground is warm paper (#FAF7EE) rather than screen-white; the ink is a deep Jaipur navy (#082746) rather than black. That pairing does the work that photography and badges do on aggregator sites — it says someone keeps records here before a single listing is read.

The register is precise, civic, and trustworthy. Restraint is the trust signal: the system earns credibility by looking accurate rather than by looking expensive or exciting. Density is disciplined but never cramped — a strict 4pt spacing ladder, tight radii (4/8/12px), and hairline borders keep the page orderly, while a warm ground and generous line-height (1.6–1.7 on body prose) keep it from reading as a spreadsheet. Terracotta (#B5532E) is the single warm accent, and its scarcity is the entire point.

Motion is functional and short. Nothing bounces, nothing exceeds 300ms, and every reveal degrades to a static page under prefers-reduced-motion. Surfaces sit flat until addressed. This system has four confirmed anti-references and rejects all of them: Indian aggregator portals, generic AI/SaaS styling, luxury real-estate gloss, and undifferentiated Silicon Valley minimal.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, navy ink — never white-on-black, never pure #000
Numbered, stamped, ruled: the ledger vocabulary of display-ID tags, status pills, and hairline dividers
One rationed warm accent against a cool navy-and-paper field
Flat at rest; depth is a response to intent, not decoration

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Terracotta marks one thing per screen. If two elements compete for it, neither gets it. Its rarity is what makes it read as emphasis rather than as brand paint.

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: The page is paper (#FAF7EE); white (#FFFFFF) is reserved for surfaces that sit on top of it. A full-bleed white background breaks the system.

rules.name: The Reserved Green Rule
rules.body: WhatsApp green means WhatsApp. Availability green means available. They are never swapped, blended, or reused for generic success states.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk sets, Geist says. Display type never runs body copy, and body type never sets a headline. A page using one face for both has lost the system.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything that is an identifier, a status, or a count — #04, AVAILABLE, 26 min — is set in the mono label style, not in body type.

rules.name: The Ladder Rule
rules.body: If a spacing value is not on the 4pt ladder, it is wrong. Reach for the neighbouring step instead of inventing one.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow is a response to the pointer, never decoration. If an element is elevated before the user has addressed it, the hierarchy is being faked.

rules.name: The Navy Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted navy, never black or neutral gray.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: One pixel, warm, #E5E0D5. Borders never thicken for emphasis — emphasis comes from color and elevation instead.

dos: Do draw every spacing value from the 4pt ladder (4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64/96px).
Do tint shadows with navy rgba(8,39,70,…) and keep surfaces flat until hovered.
Do set identifiers, statuses, and counts in the mono label style at 0.6875rem/600/0.02em uppercase.
Do keep transitions at or under 300ms on cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), and gate every motion behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference so it fails open.
Do reserve WhatsApp green (#25D366) exclusively for WhatsApp affordances.
Do use the warm hairline (#E5E0D5) for structure before reaching for elevation.
donts: Don't spend terracotta more than once per screen, or use it as general warmth.
Don't use #FFFFFF as a page background — white is a raised surface on the paper ground.
Don't ship aggregator-portal texture: badge spam, stacked ad rails, shouting CTAs, or stock-photo filler.
Don't introduce purple/violet gradients, glassmorphism, cyan-on-dark, or gradient text on headings.
Don't reach for luxury-real-estate signals: gold-on-black, thin serif capitals, full-bleed video heroes, exclusive language.
Don't collapse to undifferentiated minimal — Inter everywhere, all-gray, generic card grids. The warm ground and mono ledger marks are the identity.
Don't use bounce, elastic, or overshoot easing on structural UI; --ease-spring is for playful interactive moments only.
